# Introduction

Explainable multi-agent systems (XMAS) refers to the subfield of artificial
intelligence that integrates LLM explainability methods within multi-agent AI
systems (MAS). This recently established field of study addresses the emergent
behaviours of MAS, which derive from the added complexity of multi-agent settings.
As single-agent AI systems become progressively more commercialized (finance, e-commerce,
legal services), the natural step towards MAS necessitates the corresponding MAS-specific
explainability methods.
